comparisons.peer_topic: 2024 Restructuring Plan details and completion timeline
comparisons.peer_summary: In Q4 2024, AMD implemented a restructuring plan to align resources with AI and enterprise growth opportunities, primarily involving a 4% global workforce reduction. The company expects these actions to be substantially completed by the end of Q1 fiscal 2025.
comparisons.comparison: Both Intel and AMD disclose significant restructuring actions in FY2024 aimed at realigning their businesses, though the nature of the changes differs. Intel’s restructuring involved a fundamental change in segment reporting and organizational structure, specifically moving Altera to 'All other' to operate as a standalone business and retrospectively adjusting prior period data to reflect this new operating model. In contrast, AMD’s restructuring was a workforce reduction plan (4% global headcount) focused on aligning resources with AI and enterprise growth, with actions expected to be substantially completed by Q1 FY2025. Both disclose retrospective or realignment aspects tied to management’s internal view of performance, but Intel’s change altered the definition of reportable segments while AMD’s was an operational efficiency measure within its existing segment structure.

sentences.text: Altera was previously included in our DCAI segment results and, beginning in the first quarter of 2024, is included in "all other." As a result of these changes, we modified our segment reporting in the first quarter of 2024 to align to this new operating model.
All prior period segment data has been retrospectively adjusted to reflect the way our CODMs internally receive information and manage and monitor our operating segment performance.

In the fourth quarter of 2024, the Company implemented a restructuring plan (the 2024 Restructuring Plan) focused on driving efficiencies and aligning resources with the Company's largest growth opportunities in the AI and enterprise markets.
The 2024 Restructuring Plan will primarily reduce global workforce by approximately 4% of headcount.
